summary: Frontend-only retest of the text-size zoom fix (Playwright, 1920x1080 and 390x844). The iteration_17 HIGH bug is FIXED. Squad pitch popover at 100%: token centre equals popover centre (dx 0), 4.2px below the token. At 125%: dx 0.5px, 4.1px below the token. At 140%: dx 0. Floating-ui flips it above the token because there is no room below (popover bottom 849, token top 853, a 4px gap), and it stays inside the viewport. .app computed zoom is 1 / 1.25 / 1.4, documentElement inline and computed zoom are empty / 1, and scrollHeight equals innerHeight (1080) with no horizontal overflow. At 125% the sidebar scrolls (1218 > 864, overflow auto) and .content scrolls (scrollTop reaches 400). Player sheet at 125%: role=dialog is a direct child of body with zoom 1.25, box 1370,0 550x1080 (full height, right side), content scales and scrolls, and Esc closes it. The sonner toaster has zoom 1.25 at 125% and the toast fits inside the viewport (bottom 1050 of 1080). Iteration_17 regression checks pass. The logo-to-Home gap is 62.6px, equal to the Home box height. Themes set --bg correctly (black #000000, dim #16191E, navy #070B16, dark #08090B). Navy + green + motion off + grain off + 125% persists after reload (localStorage, --bg, --acc, html classes no-motion/no-grain, zoom 1.25). Reset restores the defaults and shows the toast. Switches use the accent colour when checked: red gives rgb(255,110,110) and green gives rgb(52,211,153); unchecked is rgba(255,255,255,.13). Mobile 390: sidebar hidden, no horizontal scroll, Appearance page usable. The only Radix popper in the app is the Pitch Popover. There are no Radix Select/DropdownMenu/Tooltip usages outside components/ui, and the Notify bell panel is a plain fixed div inside .app. Appearance was reset to defaults at the end.

issues: Popover content is not zoomed (fixed 288px wide, 16px base font), so its text looks smaller than the zoomed app around it. This is an accepted trade-off for correct placement. Optionally scale its font-size by var(--z) without using zoom.

design_issues.screen: Top bar at 140% on 1920px (known, not fixed)
issues: Date, 'Sample save · save read 1 h ago' and 'Game changes' wrap onto 2-3 lines, and the Ctrl K kbd is clipped
'FM27 · December 2027' wraps to 3 lines, 'Game changes' wraps, and the 'Raw' checkbox label is cut off at the right edge

action_items: Optional: top bar nowrap/ellipsis or hide the secondary text at 140% and on mobile
Optional: scale the pitch popover font by var(--z) so it matches the zoomed app
critical_code_review_comments: App.css: the selector body>[role=dialog] only zooms dialogs portalled directly into body. If a future Radix Dialog/Sheet is wrapped in an extra div (e.g. a custom portal container), it will not be zoomed. Consider adding a class to the sheet/dialog content instead.

Any future Radix Select/DropdownMenu/Tooltip content will be unzoomed (smaller text) by design. Recharts tooltips sit inside the zoomed .app and were not verified, because the Matches page showed no chart in sample mode.
seed_data_creation: None. Appearance reset to defaults at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Each Playwright run starts with empty localStorage. Set the size via nav-appearance -> appearance-text-{100|112|125|140}. Popover: nav-squad -> pitch-token-ST -> [data-testid^=pitch-options-]. Sheet: squad-view-tab-players -> first [data-testid^=squad-row] -> player-sheet. A sonner toast only exists after an action (Reset). To test the toast at 125%, click Reset and then 125 quickly. The Matches page had no recharts chart in sample mode.
